chunks: As for the poets, only those who go astray follow them.

key_terms.الْغَاوُونَ: Those who go astray / the erring

ai.seo_question: Who follows the poets according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted not as a blanket condemnation of all poetry, but as a critique of poets whose words lead the 'ghawun' (the erring) into spiritual deviation through empty rhetoric or falsehood. It underscores the responsibility of the poet to align their art with truth, distinguishing between those who use verse for divine guidance and those who use it for worldly distraction or misleading the masses.
